headline: Hackers use Artex to scan GitHub for exposed secrets; OpenSSH CVE-2026-123158 exploited; Zyxel GS1900 patch bypassed

bullets.text: New, ARTEX, 3 outlets: hackers are using Artex to scan GitHub repositories for exposed secrets. Microsoft separately reports threat actors using agentic AI tooling to find and abuse exposed secrets, and Truffle Security launched a program to revoke nearly 1.5 million live secrets.

Still active, OpenSSH, 5 outlets: CVE-2026-123158 is exploited in the wild hours after disclosure. Related: OpenSSH's emergency fix for long passwords bypassing SSH auth on Alpine Linux, which also reaches routers. SITCON holds at 3 (ELEVATED); last 7 days at 0.72x the 90-day average.

Still active, Zyxel GS1900, 4 outlets and top story: Zyxel's fix did not block the in-the-wild exploit (CVE-2026-107441) used to hack nearly 1,000 switches, which allows root command execution. D-Link separately warned of multiple zero-days in DGS-3130 Series switches.

Breaches still on the board: Chainalysis says credentials for all customers were exposed and it shut down key services; DigiCert exposed business customer information and identity documents; DreamHost exposed FTP logins and webmail sessions (3 outlets).

CISA KEV: the federal due date for WordPress Core CVE-2026-119977 (TOCTOU race, exploited for RCE) was today, 2026-11-06. Ivanti Connect Secure CVE-2026-104935 is due 2026-11-13; Apple CVE-2024-27834, used to deliver info-stealing malware, is due 2026-11-18.
Still active, supply chain: cPGuard autoupdate was hijacked in the OpsShield attack to serve malicious updates (3 outlets, critical).

actions: Scan your GitHub repos and their history for committed secrets; revoke and rotate anything found and turn on secret scanning with push protection.
Patch OpenSSH on every internet-facing host now for CVE-2026-123158; restrict SSH exposure and review auth logs for exploitation.
Treat Zyxel GS1900 and D-Link DGS-3130 switches as exposed: restrict management access, check for compromise, apply fixes as they ship.
Chainalysis, DigiCert and DreamHost customers: reset passwords, rotate API keys and FTP credentials, and watch for phishing.
If WordPress Core is not yet patched for CVE-2026-119977, patch it now; schedule the Ivanti and Apple KEV fixes before their due dates.
cPGuard users: check servers for malicious updates and rotate credentials on affected hosts.
